metadata.title: Atezolizumab 1680 mg Monotherapy – 28 day
metadata.indication: Locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC after prior chemotherapy; EGFR/ALK-positive disease requires prior appropriate targeted therapy. Locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma after prior platinum chemotherapy. Cisplatin-ineligible locally advanced/metastatic urothelial carcinoma with PD-L1 ≥5%. First-line metastatic NSCLC: PD-L1 ≥50% tumour cells OR ≥10% immune cells; no EGFR/ALK alteration. ES-SCLC maintenance after completed combination induction; not de novo monotherapy. Adjuvant after complete resection and platinum chemotherapy: high-risk stage II–IIIA (AJCC7), predominantly non-squamous NSCLC, PD-L1 ≥50%, no EGFR/ALK alteration; maximum 12 months.
metadata.safety_correction: Cytotoxic ANC and platelet hold thresholds removed; current v10a ICI-specific adverse-event rules encoded.

metadata.schedule_summary: Atezolizumab 1680 mg is given by intravenous infusion on Day 1 every 4 weeks (28 days). The first infusion lasts about 60 minutes; later infusions may last 30 minutes if tolerated. The visit includes checks and preparation. Adjuvant: maximum 12 months. Advanced NSCLC and ES-SCLC maintenance: until progression or unacceptable toxicity. ES-SCLC requires completed induction; this suite contains no induction chemotherapy.
